tvShows.name: Hero - Gayab Mode On
tvShows.description: Long ago, in the fight between the good and the evil, a powerful ring gets lost. This isn't any ordinary ring, for the one who wears it can become invisible. Back to the modern times, this ring finds its way to a powerful being, who is silent on the surface and stirs up a storm within. [Director - Tushar Jai Bhatia. Producer - Alind Shrivastav, Sakshi Thakkar and Nisar Parvez]
